requirements.description: Implement log_event(event_type, **fields) -> dict: all required fields, signature, append to in-memory log, return entry
requirements.detail: Supports all 5 event types. Auto-generates log_id (UUID4), auto-fills timestamp (UTC ISO). Validates required fields, raises ValueError for unknown event_type or missing fields. Computes HMAC-SHA256 signature over canonical JSON (sorted keys, excludes 'signature'), appends to _AUDIT_LOG, returns entry.

requirements.description: Implement get_log() -> list[dict] returning all stored entries
requirements.detail: Returns list(_AUDIT_LOG), a copy of the internal store. Returns empty list initially.

requirements.description: Implement verify_log(entries) -> list[int] returning indices of tampered entries
requirements.detail: Detects missing 'signature' field and signature mismatch via hmac.compare_digest (constant-time). Returns empty list for valid entries. Correctly handles empty input.

requirements.description: Integrate audit.log_event() into every relevant endpoint in app.py
requirements.detail: All 5 POST endpoints call audit.log_event() with correct event_type. GET /audit-log and GET /verify-log properly delegate. Route signatures unchanged.

requirements.description: All entries must have unique log_id (UUID4)
verify_log() must correctly detect corrupted or missing signature
Tamper detection: HMAC-SHA256 with AUDIT_HMAC_KEY env var
config_changed: 8 fields

requirements.description: log_event(event_type, **fields) -> dict: required fields, signature, in-memory append, return entry

requirements.detail: Missing signature → flagged. Mismatch → flagged. hmac.compare_digest() constant-time comparison.
